title: Multiscale closure diagnostics: matrix framework and reproducible cosmological and exoplanet tests
description: Two original working manuscripts with a corrective addendum, supplied code and frozen data, and a new execution of both empirical pipelines on 17 November 2026. The exoplanet model outperforms the single-power and quadratic baselines tested; the cosmological extension fails the stated joint success criterion. Re-execution of the same pipelines is reproducibility, not independent replication. No superiority over Forecaster or state-of-the-art regime models is established. Third-party data retain their original terms.
